name: do-stmts-test-54fb85fbab/do-stmt-negative-unreachable-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statement list includes Return and Panic, but does not include do, fail, or on fail.
reason: The negative diagnostics depend essentially on do statements, fail statements, and on fail clauses, none of which is covered by the subset's positive statement list. Supported return/unreachable-code checking alone cannot bring this whole case into scope.
test_design_notes: Contains @error expectations for unreachable statements and on fail clauses; no @args, @panic, or @output directives.
